posts.title: AI, LLMs and a step change in SW engineering
posts.description: A lot has been written about AI and LLMs for the last year and a half (probably much longer). I mostly ignored AI and LLMs outside of chat clients on the web and found even with something like Cursor, that it wasn't quite up to what I needed to be that much more productive. posts.title: Asking for engineering help
posts.description: As I've advanced in my career, I spend more and more time helping my team and others in adjacent teams with issues they're hitting. I realized that many engineers don't know how to properly ask for help from other engineers, leading to frustration and wasting time.
